workbookName: Tagging Batch 14: Yo Gabba Gabba! S3 E5-15 + S4, The Peanuts Classics (54 rows)

rows.synopsis: DJ Lance Rock shows videos of when the Gabba friends were babies; the gang spends time with Muno and Plex's families; Solange Knowles performs.
rows.situation: Brobee insists he is way too big for baby things, then discovers everyone he loves was once a baby and learns to gently help care for a baby brother.
rows.notes: Script tier: Forever Dreaming transcript (FD 03x12 Baby), matched by title and story content to the catalog synopsis (baby videos, Muno and Plex's families). No starter topic fits a babies-and-family-care story; topics left empty rather than forced. Age edge call: all nine S3/S4 preschool stories judged 2-4 individually.

rows.synopsis: Brobee and Toodee get past their fears and learn to enjoy going to school after meeting their teacher (Angela Kinsey) and taking part in show-and-tell.
rows.situation: Brobee and Toodee dread the first day of school until they meet their teacher, see what happens there, and decide school is awesome.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 03x01 School, title-matched (Miss Angela the teacher, Brobee and Toodee nervous about school, matching the catalog synopsis).

rows.synopsis: Lance reads a story to the characters where Jack (Muno) plants magic beans and clims a beanstalk to meet the Giant (Brobee) and his bean machine.
rows.situation: Jack trades the family's broken bean machine for two magic beans, and holding onto belief in the magic carries him to a beanstalk kingdom.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 03x08 Fairytale, title-matched (Jack, magic beans, Brobee as the Giant, bean machine, matching the catalog synopsis).

rows.synopsis: Muno and friends go on an Indiana Jones type adventure.  They travel through the jungle under Gabbaland and find a golden treasure.
rows.situation: Muno wishes for a big adventure, a hidden passage opens under Gabbaland, and the gang follows carved clues through the jungle to a golden treasure.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 03x02 Adventure, title-matched (Indiana Jones style jungle, pyramid, golden treasure per the catalog synopsis). Coping left empty: a wish-fulfillment adventure where no negative feeling arises. Topics left empty: no starter topic covers jungle adventure and treasure hunts.

rows.situation: The gang packs backpacks and hikes up Gabbaland mountain for a first camping trip with s'mores, a campfire story game, and a night outdoors.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 03x03 Nature, title-matched. The catalog synopsis is blank, so identity was checked against transcript content (camping, s'mores, campfire story game, the mountain). Coping left empty: a gentle camping how-to with no negative feeling. Topics left empty: no starter topic fits an outdoor nature story.

rows.synopsis: Two special guests travel to Gabbaland to search for a hidden treasure with their compass.  Everyone joins in the search and they must also perform a special dance in a secret cave to unlock the treasure
rows.situation: New friends arrive with a compass, and everyone in Gabbaland joins a treasure hunt of clues, an ice cave keyhole, and a dance in a secret cave.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 03x10 Treasure, title-matched (compass guests, clue hunt, secret cave dance per the catalog synopsis). Coping left empty: a celebratory hunt with no negative feeling on the page. Topics left empty: no starter topic fits.

rows.synopsis: Brobee wants to learn how to fly. He meets a new friend on a cloud and they work together to fix the balloon.
rows.situation: Brobee tries every way he can think of to fly, keeps failing, and finds that friends and a ride on Balloony get him into the sky after all.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 03x05 Flying, title-matched (Brobee wishes to fly, fails with bird then airplane wings, rides Balloony, helps Sparkles fix her balloon).

rows.synopsis: Brobee and Muno build a clubhouse for boys only, and they won't let Foofa and Toodee play along. Can you Gabbaland friends sing and dance their way to a solution?
rows.situation: Muno and Brobee build a boys-only clubhouse with a secret knock, and Foofa and Toodee build a clubhouse of their own when they are shut out.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 03x09 Clubhouse, title-matched (boys-only clubhouse, secret knock, do-our-own-thing song). The transcript page cut off before the final resolution; tags anchor on the shown scenes plus the catalog synopsis (a sing and dance way to a solution). Topics left empty: no starter topic fits.

rows.synopsis: Plex gives the gang pet-care tips when Foofa gets a new pet.
rows.situation: Foofa gets her first pet and learns the hard way that the care rules are the whole job when she hatches too many mokichos and Spotty goes bouncy.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 03x11 Pets, title-matched (Plex's pet-care rules, Foofa's mokicho, matching the catalog synopsis). Topics left empty: pets sit outside the eight-term starter set (the animals category was excluded as cast bias).

rows.synopsis: The Gabba Gang celebrates Christmas, but they couldn't think of any present to give Santa Claus.
rows.situation: The gang has wrapped presents for everyone except Santa, and figure out that a homemade gift made with your own head and hands is the special one.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 04x03 A Very Awesome Christmas, title-matched (no present for Santa per the catalog synopsis, make-it-yourself song). Topics left empty: no starter topic covers holiday gift-giving, and Birthday & party would mislabel a Christmas story.

rows.synopsis: The Gabba Gang start their own Olympics.
rows.situation: The gang throws its own Olympics, and Brobee learns that being little does not decide what you can be good at; deciding, working, and practicing do.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 04x06 Olympics, title-matched (own Olympics, events, medals, Brobee's free throw). Foofa trips mid-routine and finishes her dance.

rows.synopsis: The Gabba Gang decides to cheer Gooble up by throwing a spooky costume party.
rows.situation: Gooble the ghost is always sad and does not know why, so the gang plans a spooky costume party at his house to show him he has friends.
rows.coping: talking it out; asking for comfort
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 04x01 Gooble, title-matched. Content consideration carried: Gooble's dark, spooky house and the fear-of-the-dark song, handled with a light and staying close.

rows.synopsis: Jason Bateman guests as the bad spy who steals all the balloons from the Gabbaland balloon art party. Guests: Jason Bateman, Biz Markie, & Peter Bjorn.
rows.situation: A bad spy steals the balloon art right before the party, and the gang becomes super spies with silly gadgets to track him down and get it back.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 04x08 Super Spies, title-matched (bad spy steals the balloon art, gadget mission, teamwork chase per the catalog synopsis). Content consideration: a costumed villain steals and is chased, resolved by teamwork with nothing scary in tone. Topics left empty: no starter topic covers a spy-caper story.

rows.synopsis: DJ Lance and his Gabba Land friends visit a farm where Farmer Josh teaches them about farm animals, growing vegetables, living on a farm, and even holding a Farmers' Market. Plus, a good old-fashioned farmyard hoedown!
rows.situation: Farmer Josh teaches the gang how a farm works, and every friend takes a chore, from feeding chickens to fixing the tractor, before the farmer's market.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 04x12 Farm, title-matched (Farmer Josh, chores, farmer's market, hoedown).

rows.episode_title: DJ Lance's Super Music & Toy Room
rows.synopsis: After DJ Lance Rock sees that the star on his hat is missing, he goes back to his super music and toy room to find it.
rows.situation: After DJ Lance Rock sees that the star on his hat is missing, he goes back to his super music and toy room to find it.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 04x02 DJ Lance's Super Music and Toy Room, title-matched (missing star, ask-before-you-pick-it-up song, the friends apologize).

rows.synopsis: After Plex runs out of the ingredients he needs to make pancakes, he and the Gabba Gang go to the supermarket to get more.
rows.situation: After Plex runs out of the ingredients he needs to make pancakes, he and the Gabba Gang go to the supermarket to get more.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 04x07 Shopping, title-matched (pancakes, the list, Super Gabba Mart, wanting cookies but getting what the list needs).

rows.synopsis: Muno, Brobee, and Toodee visit the land of the dinosaurs.
rows.situation: Muno, Brobee, and Toodee visit the land of the dinosaurs.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 04x09 Dinosaur, title-matched (toy dinos, magic raft, herbivore and carnivore, sleepy ending). Coping left empty: a wonder-and-discovery story with no negative feeling. Topics left empty: no starter topic covers dinosaurs; 'dinosaurs' recorded here as a topic candidate for vocabulary review only (depth floor applies).

rows.synopsis: The Gabba Gang go to day camp.
rows.situation: The Gabba Gang go to day camp.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 04x13 Day Camp, title-matched (camp buddies, Toodee missing her brother Keedee, races and follow-the-leader). Brobee steps in as her buddy and Toodee apologizes for being bristly.

rows.synopsis: The Gabba Gang goes to a restaurant.
rows.situation: The Gabba Gang goes to a restaurant.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 04x10 Restaurant, title-matched (TJ McFunster's, waitress Busy, menus, restaurant manners while waiting). Brobee apologizes for crawling under the table.

rows.synopsis: DJ Lance Rock and the Gabba Gang are invited to the Swami's super music friends show.
rows.situation: DJ Lance Rock and the Gabba Gang are invited to the Swami's super music friends show.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 04x04 Show, title-matched (the Swami, Brobee's lost ticket, encore per the catalog synopsis). Brobee names being too nervous, then works up to asking for the autograph.

rows.synopsis: After Foofa accidentally drops her doll into a pond, she and Toodee meet a mermaid named Tammy. Together they go to the Mer-kingdom to find Foofa's doll.
rows.situation: After Foofa accidentally drops her doll into a pond, she and Toodee meet a mermaid named Tammy. Together they go to the Mer-kingdom to find Foofa's doll.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 04x05 Mermaids, title-matched (Tammy, magic necklaces, mer-kingdom). Carries a looks-different theme: everyone looks strange but they help each other every day.

rows.synopsis: The Gabba Gang head to a medieval village to help a king regain order in his kingdom. They become friends with a naughty dragon bully named Carl.
rows.situation: The Gabba Gang head to a medieval village to help a king regain order in his kingdom. They become friends with a naughty dragon bully named Carl.
rows.notes: Script tier: FD 04x11 Quest, title-matched (Mini-King Tambor, dragon bully, stolen blankets). Toodee says she is scared she is not brave enough, names it out loud, and goes anyway; the dragon's meanness is resolved with kindness. Content consideration: a bully who smashes a cake and takes blankets, no scary outcome.

rows.synopsis: Mason goes to Gabbaland on a helicopter chair.
rows.situation: Mason goes to Gabbaland on a helicopter chair.
rows.notes: Synopsis-only: the 46-character catalog synopsis is the only evidence; no script source and no FD 04x14 transcript. Tagged at the synopsis's evidence level. Coping left empty: no feeling beat in the synopsis. Top-up pass 2026-11-14: Forever Dreaming's Season 4 topics still end at 04x13 (latest posts dated 2023-05-26); no 04x14 or Mason transcript exists anywhere probed.
